A WORSE outcome than fake_401 and the expectation is set to 'corroborated' because that is genuinely what our method produces, not because we are matching the test to the code. Beanibazar has an independent genuine report of flooding, so this claim's location and event group ARE corroborated -- and the exaggerated casualty count rides along and inherits full fusion weight.
